resources.string: Si gaar ah u kaydi ilaa 6 sawir. Adiga oo keliya ayaa arki kara; raadinta laguma muujiyo. Ansixinta sawirrada dadweynaha weli lama heli karo. Dooro sawir ilaa 15 MB ah; xogta goobta waa la saaraa ka hor raridda.
Sawirkan gaarka ah ma ka saartaa akoonkaaga? Tani dib looma celin karo.
Hordhaca lama heli karo. Mar kale soo rar.
Hawsha sawirku way fashilantay. Hubi xiriirkaaga oo sawirrada dib u rar ka hor isku day kale. Dooro sawir la akhrin karo oo ka yar 15 MB. Kaydinta tooska ahi waxay u baahan tahay dejinta Firebase.
